whats.AI is changing Asia’s jobs market: What: AI is shifting the job market across Asia, so managers in India should start thinking about which skills their teams will need next.
whats.AI cuts job demand in exposed occupation: The IMF report points to lower job demand in AI-exposed roles, a useful nudge to plan training and role changes early.
whats.How Conversational AI Could Reshape Busi: Conversational AI, which talks in plain language, could change how businesses serve customers and run daily work.
whats.Veryon Unveils AI-enabled Business Jet M: Specialist AI tools are reaching industries like aviation maintenance, a sign that AI is moving into everyday operations work.
whats.'AI to drive growth over next decade': I: A well-known Infosys co-founder expects AI to drive growth over the next decade, so leaders should treat it as a long-term matter.

term.def: Conversational AI is software that talks with people in everyday language, by text or voice. Chatbots and voice assistants are common examples.

prompt.prompt: Act as a workplace advisor. Our team of [number] people in [department] does [main tasks]. List which tasks AI could help with, which need human judgment, and a simple first step.

quiz.q: Using an AI tool well means checking its answers, because it can sound confident even when it is wrong.
quiz.why: AI tools can produce wrong answers in a very sure tone. A human check matters, especially for numbers, names and facts.

quiz.q: If an AI tool gives you an answer, it has looked up the facts and confirmed that they are true.
quiz.why: Many AI tools predict likely words from patterns in their training. They do not automatically verify facts unless built to do so.

quiz.q: The Times of India reports that an IMF report says AI cuts job demand in exposed occupations by nearly 10% across Asia.
quiz.why: This restates the headline. It shows why managers should plan for how AI changes the tasks within roles.

quiz.q: AI only works if you know how to write computer code.
quiz.why: Most modern AI tools take plain-language instructions. Clear writing and good judgment matter more than coding for most managers.

quiz.q: The more specific your instruction to an AI tool is, the more useful its answer usually is.
quiz.why: Details such as the audience, goal, format and length help the tool give a response closer to what you need.
